blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 UP Launches 'Mukhyamantri Shikshak Cashless Chikitsa Yojana' (₹5 Lakh Medical Cover). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Provides cashless medical treatment up to ₹5 lakh/year for 15 lakh teachers and staff.
Cashless Benefit: Up to ₹5 lakh per year medical cover at empanelled hospitals for 15 lakh basic/secondary teachers and staff.
SBI Social Security MoU: SBI partnership provides group term insurance and accident cover to 10 lakh teachers.
DBT Student Transfer: Transferred ₹1,320 crore via DBT to 1.10 crore students (₹1,200/student for uniforms/stationery).
Cashless medical cover cap (₹5 lakh/yr) vs student DBT transfer (₹1,200/student).
